sheet.name: Firstmen Lictor Hunters

traits.name: Battle Tactics
traits.text:
Additional Setup: Draw one Basic Battle Tactics card.

Tactics X: Resolve the effect corresponding to Tactic A or Tactic B on the drawn Battle Tactics card.

traits.name: Mangrove Deployment
traits.text:
When you kill a Lictor Hunter, immediately Spawn a new one on a Great Mangrove Terrain tile, starting with number 1 (see Clash Diagram), then going clockwise.

Treat all Lictor Hunters on Great Mangrove Terrain tiles as if they weren’t on the Clash Board. They cannot Decoy, and cannot be attacked, activated, or affected in any way until they leave those tiles.

End of Knight Round: Each Lictor Hunter on a Great Mangrove Terrain tile performs Dwell, starting from the lowest numbered Mob.

Dwell: Move the Monster miniature to the closest unoccupied space on a Swamp Terrain tile.

traits.name: Taunt & Decoy
traits.text:
Decoy: Take the miniature of the attacked or attacking Lictor Hunter, detach its base ring from it, and return that miniature to its previous space—it becomes a Decoy. Place the base ring on the respective BP card on the Mob track—it becomes the Decoying Monster. If that BP is revealed, flip it. Then, place a Generic token on this Trait. If that Lictor Hunter is already Decoying, ignore this keyword.

When a Decoying Lictor Hunter activates, treat all Knights as adjacent and in sight during its Attack.

For every Generic token placed on this Trait, all Lictor Hunters gain the following stacking effects:
1 token: All Monster Attacks cause an additional -1 [V] loss.
2 tokens: All Monster Attacks have +1 [die].
3 tokens: All Monster Attacks gain “After Attack: Gain the Exposed Condition card.”
4 tokens: After resolving the current action, activate the next Lictor Hunter and add another AI Activation token on the leftmost BP without an Activation token on it.

traits.name: Seek & Destroy
traits.text:
Treat all Decoys as Lictor Hunters with the Lumbering Basic Ability. Decoys on Swamp Terrain tiles have -1 [AT] and +2 [To Hit]. When you attack a Decoy, it loses -1 [To Hit] for every Fire token in the Knight Pool.

If a Decoy is hit, after the first ability window, reveal the leftmost unrevealed BP on the Mob track with a Decoying Monster on it, and resolve the Power Roll against the Decoying Monster. Additionally to normal Monster Responses, resolve the following first: attach the miniature to the base ring (it is no longer a Decoy), and, if you failed to wound, place it on the Board as if you were Spawning a new Lictor Hunter. If all BP cards with Decoying Mobs on them were already revealed, immediately perform Routine.

traits.name: It’s a Trap!
traits.text: BP cards of all Decoying Mobs gain “INSTINCT: All Knights in Zone 1 lose -1 [V]. Place X Fire tokens in the Knight Pool, where X is the number of Knights that lost [V].”

traits.name: Advanced Tactics
traits.text: Replace the Basic Battle Tactics cards with Advanced Tactics cards.

traits.name: Combat Flexibility
traits.text: If you kill a non-Decoying Mob, after you finish your Attack, the next non-Decoying Mob on the Mob track performs Signature against you.

notes: Note that some miniatures and tokens are placed on Terrain tiles!
This Clash uses numbered Terrain tiles—we advise placing the numbered Generic tokens on these Terrain tiles according to the diagram as a reminder.
steps: Monster Positioning: Place 8 BP 1 and 2 BP 2 cards face down in a random order on spaces 1–10 on the Mob track. Put randomly chosen numbered base rings on 4 Firstman Lictor Hunter miniatures. Then, place those numbered Firstman Lictor Hunters miniatures on the spaces designated on the diagram and all other Firstman Lictor Hunter miniatures on spaces designated as Decoys (marked with the letter D) on the diagram. Note the facing direction indicated by the arrows.
Additional Setup: Follow additional Clash Setup instructions introduced by Traits (if any). Set aside all Battle Tactics cards not used in this Clash.
